name: Visitor's Visa

qualifying_event.description: A non-citizen from a visa-required country visiting Botswana (e.g. to see friends or relatives, or as a returning resident who has been abroad over 6 months) applies for a Visitor's Visa through the Department of Immigration and Citizenship.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Sworn statement/affidavit from a host in Botswana; host's ID or permit documentation.

requirements.blocker_text: Applies to non-citizens from countries that require a visa to enter Botswana as visitors; Commonwealth citizens (except Bangladesh, Cameroon, Ghana, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Sri Lanka) and countries with a Visa Abolition Agreement are generally exempt.
A sworn statement/affidavit from a host in Botswana, with the host's national ID or residence/work permit documentation.

evidence_required.document: Host's ID or residence/work permit copy
Return ticket/onward visa or home-country residence permit

outcome.duration_length: not explicitly stated for standard visitors; up to 2 years for dependents of residents visiting under this category

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Visitor's Visa: for visiting friends/relatives, no employment permitted, 7-14 working day processing, online via evisa.gov.bw or Form 1 in person
Botswana Tourism Organisation (state tourism parastatal) -- visa-required and visa-exempt nationality lists
